components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #2dd4bf; color: #04241f; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5eead4; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(45,212,191,0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #2dd4bf; background: rgba(45,212,191,0.1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: HEVEN.FUN reads as a premium dark commerce vault: valuables stored behind a confident, fast interface. Surfaces stay quiet and layered; teal appears as a rare signal on actions that move money or trust.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black cool-charcoal background with stepped slate surfaces
Bebas Neue display over Rubik body (Vault skin) at heavy weights for commerce headlines
Primary-signal glow reserved for hover, CTA, and promotional emphasis
12px corner radius as the default container language
DaisyUI 5 themes (6 skins, dark+light each); CSS transitions for hover/focus

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal fill or glow on ≤15% of any viewport. If everything glows, nothing is urgent.

rules.name: The No-Shout Rule
rules.body: Display clamp max stays at 4.5rem (~72px). Larger reads as discount spam, not premium.

rules.name: The Glow-On-Response Rule
rules.body: Glow appears on hover, focus, or active promotion — never as the default resting state for every card.

dos: Do keep the void background dominant and step surfaces for hierarchy.
Do show trust signals near CTAs on commerce pages.
Do test AR and EN copy at the same visual weight.
Do use glow and motion on the element the user is about to click.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS patterns: cream backgrounds, hero metric templates, uppercase tracked eyebrows on every section, identical icon-card grids.
Don't use gradient text for headlines — solid base-content or teal only.
Don't pair 1px border with wide soft drop shadow on the same element.
Don't use Ink Dim for body copy on Vault Void.
